sloka: न संतापं महाबाहो मदर्थं कर्तुमर्हसि ।पूर्वनिर्माणबद्धा हि कालस्य गतिरीदृशी ।। ७.१०६.२ ॥
transliteration: na saṁtāpaṁ mahābāho madarthaṁ kartumarhasi ।pūrvanirmāṇabaddhā hi kālasya gatirīdṛśī ।। 7.106.2 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed one, you should not grieve for my sake, for such is indeed the course of time, bound by preordained destiny.
